Name: Rescue: Captured Pilot on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: Rescue contract. One of our pilots is held at the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>. Recover her alive. Her ship can be replaced. Payment on contract completion.

LogEntries.Entry: A pilot set down near the <Alias=TargetLocation> to wait out a fault, and the occupiers took her inside. She is still alive.
The guard captain at the <Alias=TargetLocation> is dead. The pilot's cell runs off a terminal somewhere inside.
The cell terminal's lock was a four digit code. It was 1-2-3-4. The pilot is free inside the <Alias=TargetLocation>.
A pilot was taken at the <Alias=TargetLocation>. I took the guard captain, opened her cell and walked her out.

Objectives.DisplayText: Defeat the guard captain at the <Alias=TargetLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You're not one of them. They'd never have opened that door that fast. I set down to fix a coolant fault and got captured by people who couldn't fix it either.
Let's get you out of here.
Yes. Please. And if my ship's still out there, I'm taking it. Coolant fault and all.
Not really. They mostly argued about what I was worth. The number kept going down. That was the worst part.
Why set down here at all?
It was the only flat ground for a long way. In fairness to the ground, it was very flat.
If you're here to feed me again, I'll pass.
Our pilot's in there somewhere, and they'll keep her near whoever's in charge. Bring her home. The ship I can replace.
Is that the one with the keys? Then she's in a cell off their terminal. Open it.
